artifact_root: paths in data.pose_artifact are relative to this file's directory

coordinate_conversion.rotation_rule: q_actor = q_conv * q_source (component-space; bone-local axes unchanged)
coordinate_conversion.yaw_convention: positive yaw rotates +X toward +Y; anatomical left turn => negative actor yaw
coordinate_conversion.root_motion_handling: root bone track extracted into data.root_motion (delta from frame 0); pose artefacts are root-relative so the displacement exists exactly once

skeleton.source: bones arrays of raw pose files (identical across all sampled clips)
skeleton.note: No bind/reference pose or extra bones are provided; none are invented.

params.method: horizontal root displacement / loop duration
